Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as Melania the Younger, nun of Rome, from the Menologion of Basil II, whose entry for her is at 31 December — the day this folder records as her Greek feast. That separates her from Melania the Elder, her grandmother, kept 8 June. Commons describes it: Saint Melania the Younger. Miniature from the Menologion of Basil II
